title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Scope of Practice - Wills
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A client who was very impressed with a paralegal's work in Small Claims Court asks the paralegal to draft their Last Will and Testament. The paralegal uses a standard template from the internet. Has the paralegal committed professional misconduct?
options: No, drafting a will is considered an administrative task that anyone can perform.
No, provided the paralegal charges less than a lawyer would charge.
Yes, drafting wills is explicitly outside the authorized scope of practice for paralegals in Ontario.
Yes, unless the paralegal has a lawyer review the finalized document before it is signed.
questions.explain: Under LSO By-law 4, a paralegal's scope of practice is limited to representing clients in Small Claims Court, specific Ontario tribunals, summary conviction criminal offences, and POA matters. Estate law, Family law, and Real Estate are outside their scope. Practicing outside scope is unauthorized practice.
